title: ACCA Qualification
summary: The ACCA qualification develops strategic business leadership and high-level accounting skills across 13 exams (unless exemptions apply), an online Ethics and Professional Skills module, and 36 months of practical experience.

standard.name: Standard Pathway
standard.blurb: Complete the 3 tiers of exams, the Ethics module, and 36 months of supervised practical experience (PER).

nodes.name: Check Academic Entry Route
nodes.description: Confirm your starting level: Foundation In Accountancy (FIA) for school leavers without minimum criteria, or direct entry with 2 A Levels + 3 GCSEs / Bachelor's degree.

nodes.name: Register as an ACCA Student
nodes.description: Create your myACCA portal account, submit educational transcripts for exemption evaluation, and pay initial registration fees.

nodes.name: Business and Technology (BT)
nodes.description: Organizational structure, governance, ethical dilemmas, digital finance transformation, and corporate leadership fundamentals.

nodes.name: Management Accounting (MA)
nodes.description: Costing methodologies, budgeting techniques, variance analysis, and operational performance measurement.

nodes.name: Financial Accounting (FA)
nodes.description: Double-entry accounting, trial balance reconciliation, and drafting standard IFRS financial statements.

stages.title: Stage 3: Applied Skills
stages.subtitle: 6 session-based computer exams (March, June, Sept, Dec)

nodes.name: Corporate and Business Law (LW)
nodes.description: General legal framework, contract law, corporate formations, capital financing, and insolvency regulations.

nodes.name: Performance Management (PM)
nodes.description: Advanced cost management, quantitative pricing strategies, risk assessment, and divisional performance evaluations.

nodes.name: Taxation (TX)
nodes.description: Computation of taxable liabilities for individuals and corporate entities under regional tax law variants.

nodes.name: Financial Reporting (FR)
nodes.description: Applying single entity and consolidated group IFRS accounting standards, lease accounting, and ratio evaluation.

nodes.name: Audit and Assurance (AA)
nodes.description: External audit engagements, audit planning, internal control testing, substantive procedures, and reporting.

nodes.name: Financial Management (FM)
nodes.description: Investment appraisal (NPV/IRR), working capital strategies, business valuation, and currency/interest risk hedging.

nodes.name: Strategic Business Leader (SBL)
nodes.description: A 3-hour 15-minute integrated case study assessing senior leadership, enterprise risk, strategic governance, and professional acumen.

nodes.name: Strategic Business Reporting (SBR)
nodes.description: Mastery in advanced financial reporting, ethical challenges faced by CFOs, complex group structuring, and current reporting issues.

nodes.name: Advanced Financial Management (AFM)
nodes.description: Option Paper: Multinational corporate finance, cross-border M&A valuation, derivatives, and sophisticated hedging.

nodes.name: Advanced Performance Management (APM)
nodes.description: Option Paper: Strategic management accounting, value-based metrics, and high-level performance measurement systems.

nodes.name: Advanced Taxation (ATX)
nodes.description: Option Paper: High-net-worth tax planning, cross-border corporate restructuring, and advanced wealth management.

nodes.name: Advanced Audit and Assurance (AAA)
nodes.description: Option Paper: Group audit engagements, forensic audit procedures, quality management, and partner-level reporting.

nodes.name: Ethics & Professional Skills Module (EPSM)
nodes.description: An interactive 20-hour online module exploring commercial awareness, data analytics, sceptical inquiry, and ethical problem-solving.

nodes.name: 36 Months Practical Experience Requirement (PER)
nodes.description: Achieve 36 months of supervised accountancy/finance work experience signed off by an approved Practical Experience Supervisor (PES).

nodes.name: Achieve 9 Performance Objectives
nodes.description: Demonstrate workplace competence across 5 essentials and 4 technical performance objectives documented in the PER online recorder.

nodes.name: Apply for ACCA Membership
nodes.description: Transition from ACCA Affiliate to ACCA Member, earning the right to use the globally recognised 'ACCA' designation.
